tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request Dahlia Mossbutton's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include the 2018 will and health care directive prepared by Cassian Willowdoodle, any revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Note that the 2018 documents name Lina Mossbutton as primary fiduciary and health care decision-maker and predate the 2023-09-16 marriage to Owen Cloudpuddle. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to Dahlia Mossbutton and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to collect those estate document copies by 2023-11-10.
